reviews.x: It’s hard finding good brown eyeliner! I’ve been dying to try stamps to see if it would make wings easier. Pleasantly surprised - love the color, the ease of stamping, and it lasts all day without smudging! Would definitely buy again.

reviews.t: That it is a good product, however delivered damaged from the company packing facility.
reviews.x: Liked the left wing marker. The right marker leaked out of container, it came this way with the brown liner dried to the cylinder plastic marker. So, unfortunately the right one does not stamp correctly and with enough brown liner. The right fine liner part is dryer than the left pencil marker as well, which works great. Had to fill it in with my own brown liner. Disappointing, but will have to make do.

I'm a 65 yr. old grandmother who has recently been trying to figure out how to have "wings" on my eyes. After many failed attempts with regular eyeliner, this stamp has made it super easy and I love it!  I have wrinkles around my eyes so I have to fill it in a little after i use the initial stamp. But the stamp lines it out perfectly. So glad I bought this product and give it 5 stars for sure!

reviews.t: Long lasting, but not always a sharp wing point
reviews.x: When they say long lasting, they mean it!! It lasted through a shower, workout, and didn’t smudge or flake all through the night. It’s also really easy to use. The only issue is that the stamp doesn’t always stamp the point at the end of the wing.

reviews.t: Works well for those with watery eyes.
reviews.x: Product worked very well, I have a lot of allergies so my eyes water a lot but this stayed on all day. It did start to smudge just a bit by the end of the day but not bad. It’s also great because I cannot make wings to save my life.
The stamp was dried out. It stamped maybe 25%. The product looks like marker and it’s patchy. Honestly the worst eyeliner I’ve ever tried. The brown shade is very warm and bordering on orange.
First time I've ever been able to create this fabulous look. Love, love, love it! Bought in brown for fair skin.
Gave this to a just turned 13 grandchild and she loved it. Easy to use and looks professional.
Awesome product. It works just as described love it

The concept of this product is amazing because I can’t ever seem to get the wing to look the same on both eyes. However, I’m a little underwhelmed by the actual product. First off, the right wing stick never has done very well - the stamp has never fully worked and I always have to go over the wing with the pen end. And that pen always goes on really light. The left wing did great for the first couple weeks and then the stamp on it wasn’t working properly and I had to go over that one too.  Also

reviews.t: Does the job! Brown not the same color on both sides
reviews.x: It's exactly what I ordered. I got the brown and the stamps are good, they have enough eyeliner (ink? Liquid?) that they print well the first time, but don't spread or drip. But it came with two pens and the brown on the liner sides are almost entirely different shades. It's weird. I just kind of spread the colors together while the liner is still wet so the colors match lol. Not a bad compromise

reviews.t: Love that there is FINALLY an eyeliner stamp in brown!
reviews.x: I love this pen and stamp idea and it making the winged eyeliner look actually doable for those with lesser skills. Unfortunately, in the past I’ve had to miss out on this trend because I am so fair-toned that solid black eyeliner is way too harsh on me. I am SO stoked to have finally found a product with the stamping feature in any color other than black 🙏

reviews.t: The pen and stamp are two different shades.
reviews.x: I tried the brown one the other day. I started by using the pen and lining my eye and then used the stamp and noticed they were 2 different shades, so it did not look good when I tried to connect it. The picture is an example on my hand of the difference in shades. I have the black liners and have not had a problem but the brown was disappointing.

This eyeliner is mediocre at best. Takes some getting used to with the stamp feature, which is understandable, but the eyeliner itself wears out pretty quick. Don't think about working out with this eyeliner on. It disappears with the slightest sign of sweat or water. So many 5 star reviews because you get something in exchange for a good review.

reviews.t: Two different colors in the same stick!! :(
reviews.x: I am super disappointed. :( I put it on my hand and the stamp and pen side are two different color browns. I wore it thinking maybe no one else would notice and my husband picked up on it (I mean, he didn’t even pick up on my haircut for two weeks so it must be pretty obvious)  This is such a cool idea I was really hoping it was a great product.

Great wing stamps. I’ve already reordered. They stay on all day/night if you don’t smudge them. Only 4 stars though, because you really do need to use these in addition to another liner (stamp your wing, then use a different liner to fill in), but the pen part is good for touch ups and perfecting your lines. I LOVE that they come in brown!!

No tiene buena duración. Se cae fácilmente y el acabado es transparente, necesita de varias pasadas. Al poco tiempo de tenerlo se tornó de café a un tono rojizo. That doesn’t have a good longevity and the color turns from brown to red very quickly. And it is very transparent.

reviews.t: cute but after two days the stamp dried out.
reviews.x: i was so excited for this product. when i tried it out i realized that the stamp and the liner were two different colors. the liner itself was much browner than the stamp. then about two days after i bought it the stamp dried out and wouldnt do anything.

reviews.t: Not easy to use for ME!
reviews.x: I'm the problem. This eyeliner is amazing, high quality, and probably great for someone who has any sense about applying eyeliner. Unfortunately, I do not. And I don't have the dexterity, either. Fail - but only because of the user, not the product.

reviews.t: Nice concept but a bit light with one stamp.
reviews.x: Really liked the concept of this product. It was a little difficult to manage a dark enough wing. I had to go over it a couple of times so it wasn’t as neat as it should have been. Still looked good and better than I could have done free form.

The stamp eyeliner works well for something quick and simple. if you are going for something fancy you will need another eyeliner and to fluff it out to match your eyes, if its monolid or hooded eyes. Otherwise not bad for the price.

I like the concept of this and as long as you don't have a hooded eyelid they work great.  mine are slightly hooded which makes it tough to get in on properly but the product itself is a nice smooth liquid and goes on nicely.

Bought this from the Buzzfeed article and all the great reviews but I couldn’t get it to work well. The first two attempts came out okay but after that it seemed to lose ink and I returned it. It was fun to try though!

It makes great stamps for the wings but the opposite end with the eye liner does not work. It's not dried up or anything. It just doesn't work. I end up using another liquid liner to go over the stamp and line my eyes.

Love this winged eyeliner stamp! Makes doing a cat eye so much easier. The eyeliner side of the pen isn’t that great. But I don’t care. I use another type of eyeliner to line my eyelids. I will be buying this again!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the stamp easy to use and helpful for creating winged eyeliner, especially for those who struggle with wings.
Several reviewers report the product is long-lasting and smudge-proof through the day, showers, and workouts.
A common complaint is that the brown pen and stamp sides are two different shades, making the liner look inconsistent.
Some reviewers received dried-out or damaged stamps that did not stamp fully or correctly.
Some reviewers note the stamp does not always produce a sharp wing point or requires going over the wing again.
